Meet Your Artist

Hi, I'm Simone — your bridal makeup artist.

Mac trained with 15+ years' experience — including several years freelancing and teaching makeup lessons in Australia — I specialise in soft, skin-first bridal makeup that photographs beautifully and feels weightless.

Based in Cork and fully mobile across Munster, every appointment is a personal, one-to-one experience built entirely around you.
